name: The Lord of Blackrock
summary: In Orgrimmar, Nefarian's severed head is brought before the Horde. After Thrall confirms the black dragon's death, he sends the victor to High Overlord Saurfang in the Valley of Strength to show the trophy to all.

sections.title: A Trophy for the Horde
sections.body: Nefarian's head reaches Orgrimmar after the black dragon is slain atop Blackwing Lair. Warchief Thrall confirms that Deathwing's son has fallen, then sends the victor to High Overlord Saurfang in the Valley of Strength. There, the remains are prepared for public display, a warning to enemies and a rallying cry for the true Horde.

sections.title: Claiming the Legacy
sections.body: Nefarian ruled the heights of Blackrock Mountain, bending the Blackrock orcs and the Dark Horde to his will. By striking him down and raising his head in the Valley of Strength, Thrall's Horde deals a mighty blow against the Black Dragonflight. Saurfang calls on all of Orgrimmar to rejoice in the Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
faq.answer: After proving Nefarian's death to Thrall, you report to High Overlord Saurfang in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. The severed head is put on public display, and you receive honors.

High Overlord Saurfang is a veteran orc warrior and one of the Horde's greatest champions. He is stationed in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength, where he receives the head and has it mounted for all to see.

faq.q: Why is Nefarian's head put on display?
faq.answer: Nefarian's mounted head proves that the master of Blackrock Mountain has fallen. Its display strengthens the morale of Orgrimmar's defenders, and everyone in the city receives the Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer.
Nefarian was a great black dragon and a son of Deathwing. From Blackwing Lair atop Blackrock Mountain, he commanded the Blackrock orcs and the Dark Horde and bred the chromatic dragonflight.

faq.q: Where is High Overlord Saurfang located?
faq.answer: Saurfang is in the Valley of Strength, Orgrimmar's central entrance district.

faq.q: What role does Thrall play in this?
faq.answer: Warchief Thrall receives Nefarian's head first. After confirming the dragon's death, he sends you to Saurfang to have the trophy officially mounted.

angles.text: For the Horde, Nefarian's public display proves the reformed Horde's might against the black dragon who manipulated the orcs of Blackrock Mountain. It reinforces Thrall's new order.
As an orc, you may feel deep catharsis at the fall of the dragon who held the Blackrock clan in thrall. His defeat lifts a dishonorable shadow from your people.
